race.ui.cars.title: Cars compared
race.ui.cars.hint: Measured from every loaded lap of each car, hits and the air left out. Grip is what the car held for half a second, not a single moment's spike; "rear caught" counts the times it slid past 10° of drift (20° on loose ground) with the wheel turned against the corner. Pull is full throttle at each speed; it tops out where it stopped gaining at full throttle on a straight - or, where no straight was long enough, it was still pulling as much at its fastest. In "Where to improve", each corner says what of it the cars decide.
